title: Japanese Digits
statementMd:
In Japanese, the digits $1$ through $9$ are pronounced as follows:

| Digit | Japanese |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `ichi` |
| 2 | `ni` |
| 3 | `san` |
| 4 | `yon` |
| 5 | `go` |
| 6 | `roku` |
| 7 | `nana` |
| 8 | `hachi` |
| 9 | `kyuu` |

To read a multi-digit number, simply concatenate the Japanese readings of each digit from left to right. For example, $15$ is read as `ichigo`, and $893$ is read as `hachikyuusan`.

What is $72$ in Japanese?

## Input

This problem has no input.

## Output

Output a single string — the Japanese reading of $72$.
statementZhMd:
在日语中，数字 $1$ 到 $9$ 的读音如下：

| 数字 | 日语 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `ichi` |
| 2 | `ni` |
| 3 | `san` |
| 4 | `yon` |
| 5 | `go` |
| 6 | `roku` |
| 7 | `nana` |
| 8 | `hachi` |
| 9 | `kyuu` |

要读出一个多位数，只需将各位数字的日语读音从左到右依次拼接。例如，$15$ 读作 `ichigo`，$893$ 读作 `hachikyuusan`。

$72$ 用日语怎么读？

## 输入格式

本题没有输入。

## 输出格式

输出一个字符串，表示 $72$ 的日语读音。
